column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: Paths are built with path.join and the TLS code is node:tls, which Bun and Node share; every network call has a time limit (the handshake 10 s, the request 30 s, the probe 10 s). CI runs the suite on both boot-machine platforms and as a user who is not root: .github/workflows/ci.yml job "check" (Bun and Node) and job "suite" (matrix windows-latest, macos-latest); the tests that start openssl or a server carry { timeout: 180_000 }.

The four checks run in bun run ci with their baselines; this change adds to tools/mizan.baseline.txt only the six pending decisions of ontology/stolos/audit.ts (Lease, PortForward, Route, WifiNetwork, RouterHealth, EmailSender), and nothing to the trace or layers baselines.
